displayPattern: LED behind the blower-door view port on a York TG9S. Each flash is 1/3 second on and 1/3 second off, then a 2-second pause: 3 red flashes
meaning: The pressure switch contacts are open when they should be closed.
causes: Disconnected pressure switch or inducer wires
diySteps: Look at the outdoor vent pipe for snow, ice, leaves or a nest. Do not take the pipe apart
Technician: check the inducer, the pressure switch hose, disconnected pressure switch or inducer wires, and the pressure switch
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if the vent pipe is clear and 3 red flashes continue. Do not jumper or adjust the pressure switch.
